title: 商品涨价
problem_statement_md:
你正在开发一个商品管理程序，它将商品的价格存储在一个数组中。

现在需要增加功能，为每个商品涨固定的价格。

变量**increase**来自用户输入。你需要将给定数组中的所有价格增加这一数额，并将最终商品价格结果数组输出到控制台。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Store Manager[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on a Store Manager program, which stores the prices in an array.
You need to add functionality to increase the prices by the given amount.
The [b]increase[/b] variable is taken from user input. You need to increase all the prices in the given array by that amount and output to the console the resulting array.
[note]Use a loop to iterate through the array and increase all items.[/note]
hint_md: 使用一个循环来遍历数组并增加商品价格。
